reviews.text: I've been coming here for years. Never had an issue. Dr. B and staff are amazing. My suggestion is to call and make an appointment. Walk ins are welcomed. We've had many dogs and all seen by them. We will keep coming back for their service and professionalism.  Thank you all.

When ever our fur baby isn't doing the best amd we need to take him, we like the team here, super nice and the doctor gives follow up calls and gives loads of information depending on the issue. If more human doctors cared half as much the doctor here, well more people wouldn't hate going to the hospital nearly as much thats for sure!

This is where I bring my two cats and I’ve been bringing them here for about six years now. Dr Bandele and the staff are all great and the doctor is really good at answering any and all questions you might have. He also sends me articles to read when I ask him questions about stuff I’ve read on my own.

The most recent visit was for my 14 year old boy Chulo, which needed a very thorough dental treatment under anesthesia and he’s also been brought in for a benign tumor removal. Each time he’s been treated with the utmost care. The doctor even calls me a few days later to check how he’s doing. I would recommend this vet as having reasonable prices and wonderful and caring doctors and staff.
Australia heart doctors
Love Dr. Bandele! I have been going here since 2019 and he’s the best vet. Prices are affordable, the care is comprehensive, and the staff are wonderful!

LA Central Animal Hospital and Dr. Bandele are THE BEST! I've been going there for 5 years now and I cannot recommend them enough. Between their reasonable prices and gentle, thoughtful bedside manner, I always feel that my ~11year old rescue dog Hank and I are taken care of (especially when it comes to scares and tough decisions!!). Dr. B has seen my pup through 2 surgeries (1 of which was an amputation on his front leg), teeth cleanings, fleas, weird bumps, etc. and they also do wonders to help me with working with my insurance (I have Pets Best) to ensure we get the most benefits possible. If you're looking for a vet that will make you and your pet feel seen and heard, this is it!

I’ve been going to Dr. B for many years and they’ve done an amazing job taking care of my 2 dogs. Most recently, Dr. B performed an emergency spay on my 10-year-old dog and she recovered in record time. The procedure went without a hitch and that’s thanks to Dr. B’s fast response to her condition. We couldn’t afford the procedure up front so we were able to utilize Cherry and pay in installments (similar to Care Credit).

My 1 star off is for the old facilities and sometimes miscommunication from the front staff esp around pricing of big procedures.

I highly recommend this vet!
Took my dog to get checked out for vomiting and turns out he needed surgery done. I’m glad I took him and really grateful for Dr. Bandele and his staff. Now my dog needs to recover.
The staff is wonderful plus the better doc is an excellent knowlegeable. The kitty was needs to be fix and also has a little surgery. Glad I went there.
Helped my dog who swallowed a whole bottle of supplements. Took care of us quickly in an emergency situation

We had a wonderful experience at this office. The doctor is amazing and has incredible bedside manner. The staff is wonderful, caring, and intelligent. There is parking, we didn't have to wait, the prices were great... I highly recommend this vet!!!

Just changed vets to LA Central Animal Hospital and couldn't be happier. My dog has been suffering from allergies for over a year, constantly crusty eyes, and after one visit to LA Central, the doctor did a few tests, something my old vet was not interested in, and found a diagnosis and one month later, my dog seems like a totally different dog.  If perfect organization is really important to you, this might not be the vet for you, but the level of care, concern and service is top notch.

Very sweet staff but gave us bad guidance on how to take care of our dog’s ear infection. We’ve spent hundreds of dollars here to get bad information and our pup has been suffering for months. We went to a different vet for a second opinion and turns out we were misinformed. Also very disorganized. It took months for them to send our pet’s medical records to our insurance company.

Really helpful and caring staff. They were thorough in providing information about treatment options for my dog, had fair prices, and were very flexible. Their service across all staff members is above and beyond! They took great care of my dog while removing an embedded foxtail

I went there to get my dogs skin looked at, and I left with a bill for vaccines. No help for my dogs skin, or flea treatment like the vet recommended. And they wouldn't give me a prescription so I can purchase through Chewy, only their own pharmacy web site. He was almost due for the vaccines so I got them because I paid for the visit already, but that's the last time I take any pet there. They only have time to take your money.

Had an appointment here for our cat, D.O.G. (yes, that’s her name), to get a skin test — and honestly, this place is a hidden gem for pet care.

From the second we walked in, it felt like a whole storybook. The inside is super cute, filled with trinkets and personality. The front desk setup gave me vintage bank teller vibes — in the best nostalgic way possible. It’s not sterile or soulless like most vet clinics… it’s got that Dr. Doolittle’s house energy — warm, lived-in, and full of care.

The waiting room actually feels alive. Like, it’s not just white walls and cold chairs — there’s vibe here. You can tell they’ve seen it all and still show up with real love for animals.

The doc we saw was jolly as hell — super lively and made the whole visit easy and comfortable. Our cat stayed chill the entire time, which is a miracle by itself. They were gentle, clear about costs, and walked us through all the options without pressure.

We came in worried about fur loss, suspecting mites or mange — they ran a quick skin test and everything came back clear. HUGE relief.

If you’re looking for a vet that’s actually present, experienced, and doesn’t feel like a robotic hospital — this is the place. Family vibes, honest care, and just real humans doing dope work.
New patient here service was great,doctor knows his stuff, only drawback they lost my appointment so had to wait and I hate waiting. But overall 8 out of 10
Very nice staff, the actual building needs some love.
Love my Vet, Dr. Ben and his entire team. I always feel that my pet is in good hands when I have to bring him in. Thank you all!

I can't say enough wonderful things about Dr. Bandele at our local veterinary clinic. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warmth and professionalism that immediately put both me and my furry friend at ease.

Dr. Bandele's expertise and dedication to providing top-notch care for animals is truly commendable. Not only does he possess a wealth of knowledge and skill, but his genuine love for animals shines through in every interaction. He took the time to thoroughly explain everything to us, ensuring that we understood the treatment plan and felt comfortable moving forward.

What sets Dr. Bandele apart is his ability to combine professionalism with a sweet and caring demeanor. He treated my pet with the utmost respect and tenderness, making sure she felt safe and comfortable throughout the entire visit. It was evident that he truly cares about the well-being of every animal that comes through his doors.

I left the clinic feeling grateful to have such a dedicated and compassionate veterinarian like Dr. Bandele in our community. I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone looking for a vet who not only excels in their field but also brings a level of kindness and warmth that is truly special.

Thank you, Dr. Bandele, for your exceptional care and unwavering commitment to our beloved pets. You are a true gem in the veterinary world!
Wouldn't allow me to get flea meds even tho it was less than one year since the last exam. Didn't seem to care. Bad service, so I decided to go to a different vet.
Excellent care and dedication from the doctor and his assistant; they are very kind. Eternally grateful for saving the life of my precious dog, Emmy.
Thank you for helping me save my dogs life 🙏🙏🙏 …
